title.narrative: Humanitarian aid provided by the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia to the Ukrainian people

description.narrative: Delivering to the government partner (4,000) refrigerators, (4,000) washing machines, (4,000) drying machines, (4,000) microwave ovens, (90) electric generators, and (50,000) baby formulas.

Providing non-food items including (4,000) refrigerators, (4,000) washing machines, (4,000) dryers, (4,000) microwave ovens, (90) electric generators, and (50,000) baby formula via an air bridge consisting of 18 aircraft, and delivering these items to the partner (UAIM HUMANITARIAN FUND).

The project aims to support the response to the most needy groups in Ukraine by purchasing (4,000) refrigerators, (4,000) washing machines, (4,000) dryers, (4,000) microwave ovens, (90) electric generators, and (50,000) baby milk.
